columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp when the event was ingested into Log Analytics

columns.name: ActivityId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the activity event

columns.name: AccountKey
columns.description: The Duo account key (akey) associated with the event

columns.name: Ts
columns.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the activity event from Duo

columns.name: ActionName
columns.description: Type of admin or user action performed (e.g. user_create, admin_login, user_update)

columns.name: ActionDetails
columns.description: JSON string with additional details about the action performed

columns.name: ActorKey
columns.description: Duo key of the actor who performed the action

columns.name: ActorName
columns.description: Display name of the actor (admin username or user display name)

columns.name: ActorType
columns.description: Type of actor: admin, user, or system

columns.name: ActorDetails
columns.description: JSON string with additional details about the actor at time of event

columns.name: TargetKey
columns.description: Duo key of the object that was acted upon

columns.name: TargetName
columns.description: Display name of the object that was acted upon

columns.name: TargetType
columns.description: Type of target object (e.g. user, admin, phone, group, integration)

columns.name: TargetDetails
columns.description: JSON string with additional details about the target object at time of event

columns.name: OldTarget
columns.description: Previous state of the target object before the action, if applicable

columns.name: OutcomeResult
columns.description: Result of the action: SUCCESS or FAILURE, if applicable

columns.name: ApplicationKey
columns.description: Integration key of the application context for the event, if applicable

columns.name: ApplicationName
columns.description: Name of the application context for the event, if applicable

columns.name: ApplicationType
columns.description: Integration type of the application context (e.g. adminapi, websdk)

columns.name: AccessDeviceIp
columns.description: IP address of the device used to perform the action

columns.name: AccessDeviceBrowser
columns.description: Web browser used on the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceBrowserVersion
columns.description: Version of the web browser used on the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceOs
columns.description: Operating system of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceOsVersion
columns.description: Operating system version of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceEpkey
columns.description: Unique endpoint key of the access device, if present

columns.name: AccessDeviceCity
columns.description: GeoIP city of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceState
columns.description: GeoIP state or province of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceCountry
columns.description: GeoIP country of the access device
